title: MMIR Progress Dashboard
principle: Free-first, local-first, zero-trust: ship useful defaults before paid or complex infrastructure.
current_focus: Keep first chat useful without setup.
Make local install and model activation one-click where possible.
Keep paid/provider/cloud paths blocked until cost policy is explicit.
Use the sequential backlog as source of truth for all Codex work.

status_legend.done: Shipped and guarded by local or CI checks for the current scope.
status_legend.beta: Usable foundation exists; keep improving before calling it complete.
status_legend.next: Next implementation slice for Codex work.
status_legend.watch: Needs external verification, network availability or follow-up monitoring.
status_legend.blocked: Blocked until user validation, cost approval or prerequisite architecture is ready.
status_legend.planned: Planned after higher-priority activation, security and architecture work.

repos.name: inkognitroz.github.io
repos.purpose: Public MMIR.ai app shell, chat UI, progress dashboard and GitHub Pages deployment.

repos.name: mmir-local-node
repos.purpose: Private local connector for Ollama/local runtimes, pairing and local chat contract.

repos.name: mimir-backend-template
repos.purpose: First managed api.mmir.ai implementation for protected routing, memory, knowledge and planning APIs.
repos.spend: Free by default: local/dev or file-backed storage; paid providers remain gated.

repos.name: iac-autoprov
repos.purpose: OCI runtime and infrastructure automation templates.
repos.spend: Planning/free templates; cloud spend must be explicitly approved.

repos.name: iac-autoprov-aws
repos.spend: Do not run paid AWS resources without approval.

repo_decisions.name: api.mmir.ai
repo_decisions.trigger: Split or rename only when the managed backend has deployment, auth, secret vault and cost policy ready.

repo_decisions.name: mmir-desktop

repo_decisions.name: mmir-marketplace
repo_decisions.trigger: Create only after marketplace object model, moderation, ownership and revenue policy are validated.
